title: pneumonanthe parryi
intro: Pneumonanthe parryi, commonly known as Parry's lungwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and pneumonia, thereby earning its name. The health benefits of Pneumonanthe parryi are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which also exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing coughs and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Pneumonanthe parryi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
